title: run shapes and analysis shapes, as REFACTOR.md proposes
body: Three stages, each with a small set of shapes a benchmark picks from. Only set shapes exist (util::set::shape). Run shapes: one pass, a seeding that several runs replay, or a named stage per pipeline. Analysis shapes: a matrix is one row per (query, target) with a value column per variant; a tally is one row per group with counters as columns. scores.tbl and runs.tbl are one matrix shape differing in whether a variant is a tool or a run; summary.tbl and stages.tbl are one tally shape differing in what they group by. A benchmark should describe its table rather than implement one, at a cost of one or two hundred lines rather than thousands. Shared code stays a format library that knows nothing about any benchmark's question.
